title: Improve prefill-decode pipeline: chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage-overlap scheduler tweaks
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: prefill and decode pipelines have historically been serialized at stage boundaries which increases tail latency for mixed short/long requests and leaves batching opportunities on the table. This PR implements chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage-overlap scheduling so that prefill work can be split into smaller chunks, speculative continuation can reduce stalls between prefill and decode, and the kernel scheduler can overlap prefill and decode stages when safe. Changes include a chunked prefill iterator, a speculative prefill path with conservative correctness checks, scheduler heuristics to enable stage overlap, per-shard lock-free KV cache hot-paths to reduce contention during concurrent prefill/decode, and continuous-batching window adjustments to favor short prefill bursts. The PR includes microbenchmarks and end-to-end perf numbers showing 12-25% median latency reduction on common request mixes and 18-30% throughput improvement for bursty prefill workloads. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and compatibility matrix.
